about_short_description.short_description: Stackbit is a visual editing pioneer for large enterprise webpages and applications.

product.name: Visual Editor
product.description: Stackbit offers a visual editor that enables users to update enterprise websites faster by connecting any content source and using any tech stack, facilitating live editing and preview without bottlenecks or lock-ins.

product.name: Figma Integration
product.description: Design teams can define tokens, components, and layouts in Figma and publish changes directly to their live website, streamlining the design-to-web process.

product.name: Partner Program
product.description: This program allows partners to grow their digital services revenue with access to exclusive resources, programs, and connections, aimed at building superior sites and apps.

product.name: Headless WordPress Integration
product.description: Stackbit enhances WordPress by adding in-context visual editing capabilities to websites, supporting all front-end frameworks and content sources with a single config file.

product.name: E-commerce Integration
product.description: Enables editing of all content sources in one place with a live preview, managing store data as easily as content and visuals, and adding personalization, search, and media management.

product.name: Cloudinary Integration
product.description: Integration with Cloudinary for managing images and video directly within Stackbit's visual editor, supporting any content source and SSO, with automatic image optimization.
